start.title: The Compound Interest Time Machine
start.description: Plant money seeds, advance time, and watch Compound Interest turn your savings into a fortune. Defend your Greenhouse from King Deficit!
start.clickHint: Press Enter to advance the year during the game

step0.title: Welcome to the Greenhouse!
step0.desc: You are the Chrono-Botanist, guardian of the Financial Greenhouse. Plant money seeds in the grid and let time work its magic. Enemies will come from the right — defend it!

step1.title: The Power of Compound Interest
step1.desc: Each year you advance, your plants will earn interest on their accumulated value. A Stock Tree at 12% per year doubles its value in ~6 years. Resist the urge to cash out early!

step2.title: Plant vs. Harvest — Your Big Dilemma
step2.desc: You can liquidate any plant during the Planning phase and recover its current value. But if you do it too soon, you'll miss out on future growth — that's Opportunity Cost!

step3.title: Financial Threats
step3.desc: Ant Expenses steal coins from the ground (click fast to collect them!). Impulsive Beasts hypnotize your plants. The Inflation Zeppelin makes everything more expensive. King Deficit is the final boss.

tutorial.zelda: It's dangerous to go alone. Take this seed.

savings_sprout.name: Savings Sprout
savings_sprout.desc: High defense, low risk. Generates 3% per year and shoots coins at enemies in its row.

stock_tree.name: Stock Tree
stock_tree.desc: Does not attack. Very fragile. Generates 12% per year — the highest return! May lose value during bear market years.

div_vine.name: Diversification Vine
div_vine.desc: Does not attack. Generates 5% per year. When planted next to two different plants, it boosts their yield and gives them a shield.

emergency_cactus.name: Emergency Cactus
emergency_cactus.desc: Area damage at the start of each year. Disappears at year's end and earns no interest. Emergency fund!

ant_expense.name: Ant Expense
ant_expense.desc: Fast and small. Passes through plants and steals coins from the ground. Reaches the Greenhouse to steal Capital.

impulsive_beast.name: Impulsive Beast
impulsive_beast.desc: Hypnotizes plants (paralyzes their attack). Destroy it fast or pay to wake up your plants.

inflation_zeppelin.name: Inflation Zeppelin
inflation_zeppelin.desc: Floats over the board. While alive, everything in the shop costs 5% more. Very resistant!

deficit_king.name: King Deficit
deficit_king.desc: The most powerful boss. Slow but devastating. Destroys plants in its path and steals huge amounts of Capital.

toolbar.needPlants: Plant at least one seed first!

yearResult.title: Year {{year}} — Level {{level}} Complete
yearResult.subtitle: Your plants generated interest. See how much your capital grew.
yearResult.bearMarket: Bear Market! Stock Trees lost 20% of their value this year.
yearResult.cactusDisappeared: The Emergency Cactus was used and disappeared.
yearResult.earlySellWarning: You sold {{count}} plant(s) before maturity. The opportunity cost can be enormous.

levelComplete.title: Level {{level}} Complete!
levelComplete.desc: You survived 5 years in Level {{level}}. The Greenhouse still stands!
levelComplete.victoryDesc: You completed all 3 levels and 15 years of compound investing. You're a master Chrono-Botanist!
levelComplete.stars2: Great work! You survived with some losses.
levelComplete.survivedBear: You survived a Bear Market! Patient investors always recover.

gameOver.title: GREENHOUSE DESTROYED
gameOver.subtitle: Financial enemies demolished your Greenhouse. Don't give up!
gameOver.tip: Tip: Protect your investment plants (🌳 Stock Tree) with defensive Savings Sprouts. And don't sell too early!

victory.title: MASTER FINANCIAL GARDEN!
victory.subtitle: You completed 15 years of compound interest and defeated King Deficit.
victory.hodlAchievement: You achieved the HODL trophy with {{count}} plant(s) — Hold the Door... I mean, Hold the Coin! 🏆
victory.lesson: You've learned that Compound Interest is the 8th wonder of the world. Investor patience turns small seeds into mighty trees.

pause.title: PAUSED
pause.subtitle: The garden rests while you plan
pause.hintClick: Click on the garden to place plants (Planning Phase)
pause.hintCollect: Click on 🪙 coins on the ground to collect them (during a wave)
pause.hintAdvance: Press Enter or the green button to advance the year
pause.hintLiquidate: Click on a plant to see its value or liquidate it

ponzi.title: 🧙‍♂️ Wandering Vendor
ponzi.offer: Psst! I have a Magic Seed with 500% returns — only ${{cost}}! Sounds like a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, doesn't it?
ponzi.hint: "This seed will make you rich quick... or maybe the cake is a lie?"
ponzi.portal: — The Wandering Vendor (inspired by Portal, Valve Corp.)
